news.text: The Giant And The LadyWoltemade secured: 1.98m tall#Juve, the German striker arrives from #Newcastle for #Spalletti[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]

👀 "Agreement in principle between #Atalanta and #Juventus for Juan #Cabal: loan with an obligation to buy.Now, the player will decide, as up until last night, he had not yet opened the door to la Dea."[@FabrizioRomano via @PuebloJ]
#Juve: #Sarr And #WoltemadeMercato, stop at 8 PMTwo reinforcements for #Spalletti: the #Tottenham midfielder and the #Newcastle forward. #David to #AtléticoMadrid[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#WOLTEMADE SATISFIES #SPALLETTI#Juventus, here is the 'number 9' with the characteristics required by the coach: Lucio preferred him over #ZirkzeeOn loan from #Newcastle for 4 million, medical examinations this morning. #David to #Atlético. #Tagliafico could be the final signing, if #Cabal leaves. #Sarr in Turin since last night. #Yildiz has undergone for surgery: he will return in 3 months. #Thuram is also heading toward new surgery. #Ekhator, muscle tear: out at least 40 days. #Cambiaso at risk for the #Milan match.[Front Page TuttoSport]
#GilPuche to #AtléticoMadrid B on loan from #Juve[Nicolò Corradino]

‼️🇦🇷 "#Tagliafico has an agreement with #Juventus and is still waiting for the bianconeri. Everything depends on #Cabal's exit, for whom #Atalanta is currently pushing. Meanwhile, foreign clubs have also started calling the Argentine."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @Juventus_Reborn]
👀🗣 Maurizio #Sarri to Sky Sport: “#Kristensen is injured, #Hien is a long story, otherwise we wouldn't need defenders. If #Cabal joins, I will obviously be happy.”[@Juventus_Reborn]

GJustjuve ✅ Positive contacts took place during the evening. #Atalanta will present - on September 1st - the offer for Juan #Cabal to #Juventus. A development to be monitored. [Mirko Di Natale] https://t.me/GJustjuve/72538✅ At the moment, if Juan #Cabal leaves, the favorite is Nicolas #Tagliafico from #OL. Contacts have already taken place and were positive between the parties.[Mirko Di Natale]
✅ Positive contacts took place during the evening. #Atalanta will present - on September 1st - the offer for Juan #Cabal to #Juventus. A development to be monitored.[Mirko Di Natale]

#Sarr and #Woltemade ⚪️⚫️#David to #AMadrid and, if #Cabal goes to #Atalanta, #Tagliafico will arrive.After the #Kessie blow, #Carnevali had declared that there was a possibility of completing many deals in the final hours: he kept his word.The ability to react is there. #Juventus[Dario Pellegrini]

🔙‼️ A week ago, both Nico #González and #Koopmeiners were strongly proposed to #Roma, without any margin to open a negotiation. The giallorossi had other targets, in the meantime #Juventus has found again the smile of two potential outcasts.[Alfredo Pedullà via @juventusinsidernews]
A look at the standings after two games 📜[Serie A]
#Juve, the contacts have resumed for #Cabal to #Atalanta. His sale would unlock the arrival of #Tagliafico from Lyon.[Eleonora Trotta]

😬"#Juventus and #Atalanta will negotiate again for #Cabal after tonight's match; the news is that #Juve will not let #Cabal go on loan - they are only willing to sell him outright for cash.In the event an agreement is reached, #Juve will make the move for #Tagliafico."[@DiMarzio on @SkySport via @PuebloJ]

💸 "Pape Matar #Sarr is already undergoing his medical examinations and will sign with #Juventus tonight.The deal with #Tottenham is valued at €30M (paid loan plus an obligation to buy under certain conditions: qualification for the Champions League/Europa League and playing in at least 50% of the matches).He will sign a 5-year contract, with a net salary of €2.5M plus variables that can exceed €3M per season."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]
Exclusive: #Cabal, #Atalanta has reached an agreement with #Juventus on loan with an obligation to buy under certain conditions. And they will do everything. Connected to #Tagliafico[Alfredo Pedullà]
#Cabal: tomorrow morning #Atalanta will try again.[Alfredo Pedullà]

👀 "#Spalletti has requested a third reinforcement and the target is the Argentine left-back Nicolás #Tagliafico.His agent, Christian Berit, is currently in Italy.#Lyon has given the green light for his exit, since he only has one year left in his contract (the player is asking for a two-year contract from #Juventus).A small financial compensation is being negotiated for the French club, around €0.5M plus a bonus for Champions League qualification, meaning the total deal would not exceed €2M."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]
Positive contact this evening between #Juve and Tagliafico’s entourage. Now everything depends on Cabal’s exit 🔛⚪️⚫️[Romeo Agresti]
